import sys

    input = sys.stdin.read
    data = input().split()
    
    T = int(data[0])
    index = 1
    test_cases = []
    
    for _ in range(T):
        N = int(data[index])
        P = list(map(int, data[index + 1:index + 1 + N]))
        test_cases.append((N, P))
        index += 1 + N
    
    return test_cases

def bubble_sort_with_cost(P):
    N = len(P)
    total_cost = 0
    operations = []
    
    for i in range(N):
        for j in range(0, N - i - 1):
            if P[j] > P[j + 1]:
                # Swap P[j] and P[j + 1]
                P[j], P[j + 1] = P[j + 1], P[j]
                total_cost += abs(j - (j + 1))
                operations.append((j + 1, j + 2))
    
    return total_cost, operations

    for N, P in test_cases:
        total_cost, operations = bubble_sort_with_cost(P)

    for total_cost, K, operations in results:
        print(total_cost)
        print(K)
        for i, j in operations:
